events.body:
## Context

`public/index.html` (about L80, L260, L399) links to `issues?label_name[]=good%20first%20issue`, which is GitLab syntax. Other projects use `issues?label=...`, so the page's main call to action probably shows an unfiltered list.

## What to do

1. Confirm in a browser which form git.owaspblt.org honours.
2. Switch the three links to `issues?label=good%20first%20issue`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All three links open a list filtered to "good first issue"

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-start/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```
